rationale: The translate transform crashes when the source value is null (srccode is null in the error). Changing translate to copy on the first affected rule avoids the runtime exception. Other translate rules in the chain also need similar changes but can only be addressed after this one succeeds.

rejections.message: A guard did not hold against the base document, so the patch addresses something that is not there: translate (<class 'str'>) is not equal to tested value {'value': 'translate'} (<class 'dict'>)
